s1-white: Multi-shot video with three shots and hard cuts between them. Shot 1 (0-3s): starting from the start frame, slow push-in up toward the gleaming white pyramid from the desert floor. Shot 2 (3-6s): cut to a close-up of the polished white limestone surface, sunlight sliding across the mirror-smooth face. Shot 3 (6-8s): cut to a high aerial view of the white pyramid standing alone on the golden desert, the green Nile in the distance. Keep the same white pyramid, era and lighting in every shot. Photorealistic 3D documentary reconstruction. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.
s2-today: Multi-shot video with three shots and hard cuts between them. Shot 1 (0-3s): starting from the start frame, slow push-in along the rough stepped edge of the pyramid. Shot 2 (3-6s): cut to a close-up of weathered yellow-brown core blocks, rough eroded stone texture with deep gaps between the blocks. Shot 3 (6-8s): cut to a wide view from the base showing tiny tourists from behind next to the giant stone steps for scale. Keep the same pyramid, present-day daylight and colors in every shot. Photorealistic 3D documentary reconstruction. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.
s3-casing: Multi-shot video with three shots and hard cuts between them. Shot 2 (3-6s): cut to a close-up of a hand-held stone polishing the flat white surface, fine dust drifting in the sunlight. Shot 3 (6-8s): cut to a slow tilt up along the seamless white face toward the bright sky. Keep the same white casing, ancient era and lighting in every shot. Photorealistic 3D documentary reconstruction. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.
s4-aerial: Multi-shot video with two shots and a hard cut between them. Shot 1 (0-4s): starting from the start frame, slow aerial push-in over the three white pyramids beside the Nile. Shot 2 (4-8s): cut to a low view from the desert floor looking up at the tallest white pyramid towering into the sky, small figures from behind at its base for scale. Keep the same white pyramids, ancient era and warm late-afternoon light in every shot. Photorealistic 3D documentary reconstruction. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.

s6-removal: Multi-shot video with three shots and hard cuts between them. Shot 2 (3-6s): cut to the white block being loaded onto an ox-drawn cart, workers small and seen from behind. Shot 3 (6-8s): cut to a wide view of a line of ox carts carrying white blocks across the desert toward the low medieval town with slender minarets.
